request.purpose: Execute explicit GW008 competition_group backfill from sm_action
statements: UPDATE `GW008_IMC Results` SET competition_group='DOMESTIC' WHERE game_world_id='GW008' AND (competition_group IS NULL OR TRIM(competition_group)='') AND sm_action IN ('league','leaguecup','leagueshield','charityshield')

UPDATE `GW008_IMC Results` SET competition_group='INTERNATIONAL' WHERE game_world_id='GW008' AND (competition_group IS NULL OR TRIM(competition_group)='') AND sm_action IN ('smfacup','smfashield','supercup')
UPDATE `GW008_IMC Results` SET competition_group='NATIONS' WHERE game_world_id='GW008' AND (competition_group IS NULL OR TRIM(competition_group)='') AND sm_action IN ('worldcup','interqualifier')
